entities.label: Shallow turquoise/lagoon water near shore
entities.looks_like: Light cyan/turquoise water color or voxels in shallow coastal band

entities.label: Deeper blue/offshore water band
entities.looks_like: Darker blue water color further from shore, depth gradient from shallow

entities.label: Bright pale sand beaches and curved bays
entities.looks_like: Pale yellow/tan sand top-color or beach voxels along coastline

entities.label: Sand (or gravel) seafloor under shallow water — not mud swamp bed
entities.looks_like: Sand/gravel cubes or color on the ocean floor in coastal cells

entities.label: Palm tree — trunk plus splayed frond canopy
entities.looks_like: Tall thin trunk with horizontal/diagonal green frond boxes radiating at top

entities.label: Kelp or seagrass on the coastal floor
entities.looks_like: Vertical green underwater plants on shallow ocean cells

entities.label: Bright coral/reef structures in shallow water
entities.looks_like: Colorful small cubes (pink/orange/purple) placed in shallow coastal cells

entities.label: Braided river mouths merging into ocean
entities.looks_like: Multiple cyan freshwater channels splitting and meeting ocean at delta

entities.label: Cliff waterfall — water falling off edge into void/ocean
entities.looks_like: Vertical white/cyan water column at cliff edge with downward motion or placement

entities.label: Coastal life — fish swimming in water or birds/turtles on shore
entities.looks_like: Fish voxels with swim animation in shallow water, or bird/turtle voxels grounded on beach sand

must_not_present.label: Lava or volcano on the beach/ocean
Murky stagnant swamp pools as coastal ocean
